title: Why can't family support facilitate the sustainable development of students' home-based online learning: a mixed-methods study from western China households
core_idea: To investigate why family support does not effectively promote sustainable home-based online learning by examining parental and student challenges and exploring dilemmas and potential breakthrough paths via a mixed-methods approach (questionnaire and interviews) in western China households.
tldr: The study examines parental and household obstacles to sustaining students' home-based online learning, aiming to uncover dilemmas and potential improvement paths through quantitative and qualitative research in western China.
